title: Slay The Math
description:
Poka-yoke (mistake-proofing) quality-of-life for Slay the Spire 2.

- Confirm before ending a turn with unspent energy and a playable card.
- Potion reminder in elite/boss fights.
- Combat gems flanking the energy orb: a defense gem (exact minimum HP you'll lose this turn, with a lethal danger cue) and an offense gem (max damage you can deal to any single enemy + scheduled between-turn damage), driven by an exhaustive off-thread turn simulator.
- Radial relic layout, deck-under-reward, act-start notifications, card target preview, and more.

Debug builds include an in-game live-tuning panel (F9).
